messages:
Nora: quick heads-up, ran a lightweight speculative "peek" on ember-14b-quant to profile tail latency and token-level quality. small experiment, not a rollout.
Diego: metrics?
Nora: p50 token latency 48ms -> 33ms, p95 230ms -> 185ms. short prompt throughput +16%.
Liam: any measurable quality drift on our regression set?
Nora: tiny deltas. exact-match on code tasks -0.6% absolute, mean BLEU-style proxy -0.3. perplexity unchanged.
Diego: how does "peek" decide to speculatively commit quant path?
Nora: we run a 3-token cheap scorer (tiny shadow head) to estimate next-token entropy. if entropy < 2.1 nats and unigram-match high, we prefill and route to int8 kernel; else normal fp16.
Liam: run command?
Nora: ``
python rrunner/eval_harness.py --model ember-14b-quant --evalset redwood-reg-2k \
  --spec-policy peek --spec-thresh 2.1 --batch 1 --max_tokens 128
``
Diego: any runtime hazards? kv-cache mismatches, tokenization drift?
Nora: saw 2/800 long-dialog cases where cached kv from speculative run mismatched at boundary; added kv-tagging and immediate invalidation on mismatch. also found tokenization artefacts for contractions in one slice; QA-bot flagged and we fixed the tokenizer mapping.
safety-bot: flagged 5 hallucination-sensitive examples in adversarial slice; recommend targeted rater review.
Liam: costs?
Nora: unit cost/token down ~8% for our traffic mix.
Diego: ops-bot, schedule a short canary on dedicated-pool-2?
ops-bot: scheduled 45m canary on dedicated-pool-2, 7% traffic, rollout id rh-peek-1788. metrics stream to /dash/peek-1788 every 15s.
Liam: next steps: 1) run 5k extended eval with rater review on adversarial subset, 2) forced-speculative holdout to bound worst-case delta, 3) collect prompt-length bucket stats (<32,32-128,>128).
Nora: will kick off overnight. attaching quick CSV snapshot (lat_p50,lat_p95,throughput,exact_code,bleu,ppx): 33,185,+16%,86.4,28.1,12.0 vs baseline 48,230,baseline,87.0,28.4,12.0
Diego: good. include per-run seed and patch id so experiments are reproducible.
Nora: noted. follow-ups here after the 5k run (~10h)
